messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Splitting the dose may be needed.
Taking a larger daily dose may be needed.
Metoprolol succinate (extended-release tablets and capsules) dosage for adults:
Condition | Starting dose | Usual range
High blood pressure | 25 mg to 100 mg once a day | Adjust weekly or less often.
Doses above 400 mg a day have not been studied.
Angina | 100 mg once a day | Increase weekly until symptoms are controlled or your heart rate slows noticeably.
Doses above 400 mg a day have not been studied.
Heart failure is treated with 25 mg once a day for two weeks, or 12.5 mg once a day in more severe heart failure.
The dose should be doubled every two weeks to the highest dose you tolerate, up to 200 mg once a day.
Kapspargo Sprinkle capsules are not suitable to start heart failure treatment if a dose below 25 mg is needed.
Metoprolol dosage for children:
Extended-release metoprolol is the only form approved for children.
It is approved only for high blood pressure in children aged 6 years and older.
The starting dose is 1 mg for each kilogram of body weight once a day.
Triples: [["Metoprolol", "has administration instruction", "splitting the dose may be needed"], ["Metoprolol", "has administration instruction", "taking a larger daily dose may be needed"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has dosage form", "extended-release tablets"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has dosage form", "extended-release capsules"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has recommended dose", "25 mg to 100 mg once a day"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has administration instruction", "adjust weekly or less often"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has dosage limit", "doses above 400 mg a day have not been studied"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has recommended dose", "100 mg once a day"], ["Metoprolol succinate", "has administration instruction", "increase weekly until symptoms are controlled or your heart rate slows noticeably"], ["Metoprolol", "has recommended dose", "25 mg once a day"], ["Metoprolol", "has recommended dose", "12.5 mg once a day"], ["Metoprolol", "has administration instruction", "the dose should be doubled every two weeks to the highest dose you tolerate, up to 200 mg once a day"], ["Kapspargo Sprinkle capsules", "contraindicated in", "starting heart failure treatment if a dose below 25 mg is needed"], ["Metoprolol", "has approved form for children", "extended-release metoprolol"], ["Metoprolol", "has approved use in children", "high blood pressure"], ["Metoprolol", "has approved age for children", "6 years and older"], ["Metoprolol", "has recommended dose for children", "1 mg for each kilogram of body weight once a day"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "has administration instruction", "has approved age for children", "has approved form for children", "has approved use in children", "has dosage form", "has dosage limit", "has recommended dose", "has recommended dose for children"]
Answer:

completion:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used for the condition or situation specified by the object entity.  
has administration instruction: The subject drug requires the administration method or adjustment specified by the object entity.  
has approved age for children: The subject drug is approved for use in children of the age range specified by the object entity.  
has approved form for children: The subject drug is available in the specific formulation approved for use in children.  
has approved use in children: The subject drug is approved for the medical condition specified by the object entity in children.  
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.  
has dosage limit: The subject drug has a maximum dose limit specified by the object entity.  
has recommended dose: The subject drug is typically administered at the dose specified by the object entity.  
has recommended dose for children: The subject drug is typically administered at the child-specific dose specified by the object entity.
